name: Walkie
summary: Hold a face to talk. Voice notes, files and to-dos, end-to-end encrypted and post-quantum safe.
description:
Put the people you talk to most in the notch. Hold a face and speak: your voice note is written down as you talk and plays on their Mac the moment you let go. Drop files on a face, send a screenshot, or hand over a to-do with a reminder.

Works on macOS 14 and later. Everything travels through your own XNotch Cloud server, sealed on your Mac with X-Wing (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) and signed with ML-DSA-65 and Ed25519. The server only ever stores ciphertext.
